# Explainability report: Logistic regression

<!-- Generated by `cbp explain`. Synthetic data only. -->

Exact interventional SHAP values in log-odds for 7,013 test-window transactions, against a background of 300 training-window rows (mean predicted risk 1.85%). Local accuracy holds to 7.1e-15 log-odds.

## Warnings: single-feature dominance

On at least one row, each of these features alone multiplies the odds of a dispute by 100× or more. That usually means a sparse feature seen only a handful of times in training (near separation), so its weight is extrapolated and scores driven by it are likely overconfident.

| Feature | Max \|SHAP\| (log-odds) | Max odds multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| `attempts_1h` | 13.53 | ×749,628 |
| `charged_after_cancel_request` | 7.42 | ×1,668 |
